```python
def maxSubstringLength(s):
    from collections import defaultdict
    
    char_count = defaultdict(int)
    left = 0
    max_len = 0
    
    for right in range(len(s)):
        char_count[s[right]] += 1
        
        while char_count[s[right]] > 2:
            char_count[s[left]] -= 1
            left += 1
        
        max_len = max(max_len, right - left + 1)
    
    return max_len
```
